mapper.sql: t.id, t.txn_date AS txnDate, t.txn_type AS txnType, t.amount, t.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, t.account_id AS accountId, a.name AS accountName, t.from_account_id AS fromAccountId, fa.name AS fromAccountName, t.to_account_id AS toAccountId, ta.name AS toAccountName, t.status, t.biz_type AS bizType, t.ref_id AS refId, t.biz_extra AS bizExtra, t.note, t.create_by AS createBy, t.create_time AS createTime, t.update_by AS updateBy, t.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM finance_transaction t LEFT JOIN finance_category c ON c.id = t.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.user_id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN finance_account a ON a.id = t.account_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.user_id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN finance_account fa ON fa.id = t.from_account_id AND fa.deleted = 0 AND fa.user_id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN finance_account ta ON ta.id = t.to_account_id AND ta.deleted = 0 AND ta.user_id = t.user_id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.id = #{id} AND t.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT t.txn_date AS date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type = 'income' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS incomeAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type = 'expense' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expenseAmount FROM finance_transaction t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'settled' AND t.txn_type IN ('income', 'expense') AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.txn_date >= #{startDate} AND t.txn_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY t.txn_date ORDER BY t.txn_date ASC

SELECT t.category_id AS categoryId, COALESCE(c.name, '未分类') AS categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS amount FROM finance_transaction t LEFT JOIN finance_category c ON c.id = t.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.user_id = t.user_id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 'settled' AND t.txn_type = 'expense' AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.txn_date >= #{startDate} AND t.txn_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY t.category_id, c.name ORDER BY amount DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
